### Ameriprise Financial Named One of TIME’s “America’s Best Companies” for 2026


October 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/618704162/files/doc_news/Ameriprise-Financial-Named-One-of-TIMEs-Americas-Best-Companies-for-2026-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) has been recognized by TIME as one of “America’s Best Companies” for 2026, based on employee satisfaction, financial performance and sustainability transparency. Ameriprise is also the top-ranked banking and financial services company headquartered in Minnesota on the list.


“For more than half of America’s history, Ameriprise has helped millions of people plan for a confident financial future. That purpose continues to guide how we serve clients today,” said **Jim Cracchiolo, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Ameriprise Financial** . “Being named one of ‘America’s Best Companies’ by TIME reflects the trust we’ve earned with clients, the strength of our business and an exceptional team that continues to set Ameriprise apart. We’re proud of this recognition and remain focused on serving clients well, supporting our advisors, employees and communities and building on our firm’s long record of strong performance.”


TIME, in partnership with Statista, evaluated companies that generated over $100 million in revenue in their last fiscal year. The analysis included survey feedback from approximately 217,000 employees, financial performance indicators for the last five years and publicly available data related to sustainability reporting and transparency.


This TIME honor adds to recent recognition Ameriprise Financial has received from leading third-party organizations for the strength of its financial advice, capabilities, culture and innovation, including:


- [Newsweek “Most Trustworthy Companies in America 2026”](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameriprise.com%2Fnewsroom%2Fnews-releases%2Fameriprise-financial-recognized-by-newsweek-as-one-of-the-most-trustworthy-companies-in-america&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=Newsweek+%26%238220%3BMost+Trustworthy+Companies+in+America+2026%26%238221%3B&index=1&md5=7d39ae363f0ee0fd6fac78141f836367)
- [TIME "America’s Most Iconic Companies 2026”](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameriprise.com%2Fnewsroom%2Fnews-releases%2Fameriprise-financial-highest-ranked-diversified-financial-services-firm-on-times-americas-most-iconic-companies-list-for-2026&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=TIME+%26quot%3BAmerica%26%238217%3Bs+Most+Iconic+Companies+2026%26%238221%3B&index=2&md5=ef262b91465617831ef822b99f7c9c39)
- [Fortune “America’s Most Innovative Companies” 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FAmeriprise-Financial-Recognized-by-Fortune-as-one-of-Americas-Most-Innovative-Companies-in-2026%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=Fortune+%26%238220%3BAmerica%26%238217%3Bs+Most+Innovative+Companies%26%238221%3B+2026&index=3&md5=f756ac0c2618755c6062b0c3f50efe4a)


**About Ameriprise Financial**


At[Ameriprise Financial](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameriprise.com%2F&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=Ameriprise+Financial&index=4&md5=14652c06dbbe212a90d9ff44777af9e6) , we have been helping people feel confident about their financial future for more than 130 years1. With extensive investment advice, global asset management capabilities and insurance solutions, and a nationwide network of more than 10,000 financial advisors, we have the strength and expertise to serve the full range of individual and institutional investors' financial needs.


1Company founded June 29, 1894.


TIME magazine partnered with Statista to recognize America’s Best Companies, chosen based on an independent survey of roughly 217,000 U.S. employees. Eligible companies (those headquartered in the U.S. that generated over $100 million in revenue in 2024 or 2025) were evaluated across three key categories: employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency. The final ranking reflects the period from January 2026 to May 2026. Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results.


Newsweek partnered with Statista to recognize the Most Trustworthy Companies in America. Eligible companies (headquartered in the U.S. with revenues of at least $500 million) were evaluated September to January 2026 through: An independent survey of 25,000 U.S. residents, which resulted in 101,000 company evaluations, on three touchpoints of trust (customer, investor, employee); and social listening analysis (identification and assessment of what was said about a company on various media segments of the internet). Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results. For more information:[https://rankings.newsweek.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frankings.newsweek.com%2F&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Frankings.newsweek.com%2F&index=5&md5=e145cb1796b565e8f9860aa08e669433) .


TIME magazine partnered with Statista to recognize America’s Most Iconic Companies, chosen based on an independent survey of roughly 10,000 participants. Ameriprise Financial, Inc. was the highest ranked diversified financial services firm in the ranking and its overall ranking was #48 out of 250 companies across all industry sectors. Eligible companies (founded and headquartered in the United States, with a market presence of at least 10 years.) were evaluated from July to August 2025, across several key categories: Recognition and familiarity, cultural significance and impact, emotional connection, resilience, Americanness, presence and legacy. Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated, but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results. Find more information at[https://time.com/7339929/americas-most-iconic-companies/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftime.com%2F7339929%2Famericas-most-iconic-companies%2F&esheet=54617015&newsitemid=20261006132658&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Ftime.com%2F7339929%2Famericas-most-iconic-companies%2F&index=6&md5=46f375e122a63ae11a57cde49a5e8ed8) .


Fortune partnered with Statista to recognize America’s Most Innovative Companies — U.S. companies that excel in developing innovative products, streamlining processes, and cultivating a forward-thinking corporate culture. Statista surveyed more than 30,000 U.S. employees and 3,000 experts in various fields and evaluated patent data. Surveys were conducted August through November 2025. Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated, but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results.
